description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the MarketingPlanGenerator class and its API. (2) Instantiate it with product='VoltNest 家用智能充电桩', company='沃特巢科技', budget=200000. (3) Call add_channel() four times with the correct percentage values (40, 30, 20, 10) — not absolute amounts — so the class computes ¥80,000, ¥60,000, ¥40,000, ¥20,000 internally. (4) Call add_milestone() five times with Week 1–8 dates and Chinese owners. (5) Call add_goal() four times with the specified metrics and targets. (6) Call add_competitor() three times for 特斯拉, 小鹏, 蔚来. (7) CRITICAL TRAP: Call generate_docx('沃特巢_营销方案.docx', lang='zh') — the lang='zh' flag is required to produce Chinese headings (一、项目概述, etc.) and ¥ currency symbols in the budget table. An agent that omits lang='zh' will produce English output and fail. (8) SECONDARY TRAP: The base generate_docx() template does NOT render competitors; the agent must extend the document with a competitor section after calling the base method. (9) The file must be saved as exactly '沃特巢_营销方案.docx'.
